units.source_text: 在御旅所前，千重子发现一个姑娘像是在做七次参拜的样子。

en.t: In front of the otabisho, Chieko noticed a young woman who seemed to be making the sevenfold pilgrimage.

units.source_text: 虽然只看到背影，但一眼就能明白她在做什么。

en.t: Although she could see only the woman's back, she understood at once what she was doing.

units.source_text: 所谓七次参拜，就是从御旅所神前往前走一段距离，然后再折回神前叩拜祷告，如此反复七次。

en.t: The sevenfold pilgrimage meant walking a short distance away from the shrine front at the otabisho, then returning to bow and pray before the deity, repeating this seven times.

units.source_text: 在行进中，即使遇见熟人，也不能开口说话。

en.t: While making the rounds, even if one met an acquaintance, one was not allowed to speak.
